name: Training Lab - EVPN/VXLAN ERB
description: Juniper EX EVPN-VXLAN fabric, edge-routed bridging: 2 spines, 4 gateway leaves (anycast IRB), eBGP underlay and overlay, VRFs CORP/IOT/GUEST, 4 access switches on ESI-LAGs. 10 projects and a network map in Lab and in Production. Switch root and labadmin password: Sample-Lab-Root1.
